watch.title: WE WATCH THE PORTALS
watch.body: Every federal and provincial source, scraped overnight. CanadaBuys, MERX, BC Bid, SEAO, NBON and the rest. You stop tabbing between eight logins.

filter.title: WE FILTER TO YOUR SHOP
filter.body: Matched to your trade, your province and your bonding capacity. Set-aside and certified streams flagged. No noise, only bids you could actually win.

draft.title: AI READS THE RFP
draft.body: A plain-language summary of scope, deadlines and mandatory criteria, plus a first-draft proposal so you start writing at the 40-yard line, not the whiteboard.

demo.label: Demo · 1:30
demo.photoAlt: Board-formed concrete with a single hard diagonal shadow
demo.title: NUMBERS DO THE PERSUADING.
demo.lead: Ninety seconds: overnight scraping, an AI RFP summary, and a first draft proposal, start to finish. No pitch, just the product doing the work you do by hand today.

trades.title: Trades & small business
trades.body: 5–100 people, no bid team. Construction, facilities, IT services, staffing, supply. You have won government work before. You just miss half the chances to do it again.

certified.title: Certified suppliers
certified.body: Indigenous-, women- and veteran-owned firms. We surface the targeted and set-aside programs you are eligible for, automatically. No more guessing which door is open.

consultants.title: Consultants & bid writers
consultants.body: Run one pipeline across every client account. Find, filter and triage opportunities for all of them from a single desk.

coverage.lead: Federal and provincial, watched overnight so nothing closes before you see it.

request.lead: Fifteen minutes on your own opportunities. We'll show you the bids you're missing this week. No obligation, no slide deck.
